# Phase 2 baseline metrics (generated by backbone.baseline)

Segments: 19986 (1119.5 km); with a usable reference (ref width >= 1.5 m): 19039 (1092.1 km). Tables except no_reference use those.
Widths in m. width_mae and width_bias are medians of |tag - ref| and tag - ref, where ref = reference area / scored length (rough; includes junction wedges).
